name: GO/NO-GO 11-20 16:00Z: release the efforts increment without a runnable test suite (A/B/C)
description:
## Why this card exists

PM, shift 6, turn 3, 2026-11-19T09:35Z.

Shift reports have cited a go/no-go card `8eded1c4` for **11-20 16:00Z** for several days. **That card does not exist** — a control-plane regex search for the id over 590 task files finds only quotations of it inside other cards' text, never a task file. The launch decision has therefore never been on anyone's agenda.

This is that decision, for real, dated.

## The decision (one item, three options)

Ship the **efforts increment** — 3 files, +19/-9: a refused delete now shows a visible red error banner instead of failing silently (`EffortsSettings.vue` `:375-378` → `:381-382` → `:49-52`), plus a 9-case contract suite already in HEAD.

| Option | What it means | Risk |
|---|---|---|
| **A (recommended)** | Demo to management and release to internal users. Automated tests stay red-blocked until Node lands. | A regression in the 3 files would be caught by hand, not by the suite. Blast radius is one settings screen. |
| B | Hold the increment until a Node runtime exists and the 9 tests can actually run. | Delay of unknown length; the fix is already written and the tree keeps growing (67 files / +8184-398). |
| C | Release behind a flag, demo only to management. | Same safety as A with a revert switch; costs one extra deploy cycle. |

**Recommendation: A**, with `91411767` (Node runtime) as a hard follow-up and this increment explicitly *not* a precedent for shipping without the suite.

## What must be true before the decision is taken

1. The 3-path commit actually landed — verified read-only by `f48294e8` (11-19 14:00Z), not by the card that made the commit.
2. The pre-commit gate `eb723f13` (11-19 12:00Z) reported 6/6 PASS.
3. Nobody has said "the tests pass". **They cannot run.** Any report claiming green tests is wrong until `91411767` closes.
4. The excluded features did not ride along: `TaskSettings.vue` (recurrence, +123/-0, carries the HIGH hidden-comment finding `675c4695`), `browsers.js`, `computers.js`, `responseOptions` / `voiceBargeIn` tests.

## Acceptance

- Management answers A, B or C, written on this card, by **2026-11-20 16:00Z**.
- If A or C: a one-line demo script is attached here (load presets → try to delete one that the server refuses → **red banner appears** → the record is still in the list).
- If B: state the date Node is available, and re-arm `e24eac3e` (the +8165 unowned lines) so the tree does not grow unattended.

## Out of scope

Implementing the demo environment, writing code, closing `91411767`.

### Inputs that changed since this card was written — use these, not the older numbers

1. **The 12:00Z pre-commit gate ran early and PASSED 5 of 6 checks.** Full result on `0bc8b144`. Checks 1, 3, 4, 5, 6 PASS. Check 2 (`package.json` clean) FAILs, and the finding is worth carrying into your decision:

So option **B** in your A/B/C (ship the increment, knowingly without a runnable regression suite) keeps its shape, but the reason is now stronger: the increment's *demoable* property was proven independently of Node, so the missing runtime is a regression-safety debt, not a demo blocker. If Node lands at 15:00Z the trade-off disappears and the decision becomes trivial.

## New input for the 11-20 16:00Z decision — the release risk has moved (PM shift 7, turn 2, ~12:22Z)

You already carry the gate result (5 PASS / 1 FAIL) and the proven Node-free demo. **One input changed since**, and it is not about tests:

### The index is not empty
`project_changes(scope="staged")` → **102 files staged, +10273/-52**, all `.codx/` control-plane churn. A bare `git commit` at 13:00Z would put a 3-path fix inside 10k lines of orchestration state. The commit card now mandates the pathspec form (`git commit -m "…" -- <3 paths>`) and I have posted the full recipe.

### A stale description would have vetoed the commit
`0bc8b144`'s description (immutable, card `de2da95f`) still says *"Do not commit before the 9 `ok -` lines exist"* and lists a `package.json` hunk that **does not exist**. Executed literally, the commit would have been refused. I posted a line-by-line supersede comment that withdraws items 1–4 and the ORDER block. **This is the residual risk in your decision:** if an executor follows the description rather than the comment, the increment does not land and your options A/B/C would apply to nothing.

### What that changes for the three options
- **Option A (approve Node base image)** — unchanged, still the durable fix, but it no longer gates anything today. Decide it on its own merit, not as a release condition.
- **Option B (ship without the client suite)** — now conditioned on one observable, not on a promise: **does `git show --stat HEAD` list 3 files / +19/-9 with `package.json` absent?** `f48294e8` answers that at 14:00Z. **B with a landed commit is coherent; B without a landed commit is a demo of uncommitted work.**
- **Option C (delay)** — if the 14:00Z verification fails, C becomes the recommendation, because a second attempt at the same hour cannot be verified before your decision.

### Please read the decision as
> *Release the efforts increment as a demoed, revertible 3-path commit on which the client regression suite has not run.*
Not as *"release and we will commit it later."* The commit is the deliverable; the test suite is the missing evidence.

No action needed from you until 16:00Z. This note exists so the options are argued against today's facts, not shift 6's.

## The demo your acceptance depends on now has an owner (PM shift 7, turn 3, ~12:40Z)

Your body says: *"If A or C: a one-line demo script is attached here"*. That was a promise with **no card behind it** — the script existed only inside PM report descriptions on the desk board. Deployable is not demoed, and a go/no-go cannot approve an increment nobody has driven on screen.

**New card: `2cd6e1f6-f399-4c21-85f3-e4a1f4dfe8b5`** — *M1 DEMO RUN* (`IT team` / Scheduled, wake **11-19 16:00Z**, owner `software_developer` + `devops`). It carries the full script, not a one-line summary:

- **Step 4 — built-in effort, press Delete → red banner + effort still listed.** This is the delivered behaviour, with the proven code path (`EffortsSettings.vue:375-378` → `:381-382` → `:49-52`).
- **Step 6 — throwaway effort, Delete → disappears, list reloads, no banner.** Marked **conditional on `fcf65219`** (currently 95%); if that card is not closed, step 6 is "not demonstrable yet", not "failed".
- Acceptance requires the **observed banner text quoted** — "works as expected" does not count as evidence.
- Verdict line requested: **DEMOABLE / NOT DEMOABLE**.

### What this changes for your decision at 11-20 16:00Z
The demo result now arrives **before** you decide, rather than as an assumption inside the option text. Concretely, read `2cd6e1f6` before choosing:
- **DEMOABLE** → option A/B/C is a choice about *test coverage*, which is the question you are actually being asked.
- **NOT DEMOABLE** → the increment has no demonstrated customer-visible behaviour and **all three options collapse**: the honest answer is "do not release", and the reason is a demo failure, not a test-coverage gap. Say that instead of picking a letter.

### Unchanged, still true for you
- `f48294e8` (14:00Z) verifies the commit landed and that no `.codx/` churn was swept in; a still-dirty `package.json` there is a **PASS** (the `^0.2.3` line must survive the commit — that is the proof the downgrade stayed out).
- `91411767` (15:00Z) may re-price the Node question entirely: its failure is `not found in $PATH`, not proven absence. If a probe finds node at an nvm path, the "no runnable suite" cost of option B drops to minutes.
- The regression suite for this increment remains **never executed**. Any option you pick is choosing how to carry that, knowingly.

Fact set for the 11-20 16:00Z decision, measured 2026-11-19 ~14:15Z (shift 6, card `f48294e8` — read-only verification):

- **The increment is not committed.** HEAD is `dba24f4bf27c` (unchanged all day); `src/api/modules/efforts.js` (+8/−3) and `src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue` (+8/−1) exist **only in the working tree**. Pending commit = 3 tracked paths, **+19/−9**.
- **Already on main:** `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` was added by HEAD itself (`A +139/-0` vs `HEAD~1`) and the `"test": "node --test tests/"` script is in HEAD too. So the pending delta on the test file is +3/−5, not a new file.
- **Index pollution stands:** 102 staged files / +40129−452, including the forbidden `vue3-virtual-scroller ^2.0.3 → ^0.2.3` downgrade (`package.json:64`) and `TaskSettings.vue` (+123/−0, carries the open HIGH `injection.hidden-html-comment` finding). A bare `git commit` therefore ships neither the scoped increment nor a clean tree.
- **Out of the increment, still uncommitted:** `browsers.js +65`, `computers.js +140`, `TaskSettings.vue +123`, `tests/responseOptions.test.mjs +182`, `tests/voiceBargeIn.test.mjs +87` (5 files, +597/−0).
- **No test execution evidence exists:** no `node` in the agent runtime (`91411767`), and the JS suite cannot be run here — so any option that assumes "tests were green" is unsupported.

Implication: the A/B/C choice should be evaluated on an **uncommitted** tree. Option framing "release the increment" presupposes a commit that does not exist as of now; if it still does not exist at 16:00Z, the only honest outcome is NO-GO on the tree and a decision on the *process* (why no commit path exists), tracked in `0bc8b144` / `3a86fba9`.

**Updated inputs for the 11-20T16:00Z GO/NO-GO — the options change, the recommendation does not.** (PM shift 8, 14:30Z)

1. **The commit does not exist.** HEAD is still `dba24f4`; the 3 paths are still dirty (+19/−9). The 13:00Z slot expired.
2. **It cannot be created by an AI agent.** 14:28Z run of `0bc8b144` → `commit not executable: no shell/exec tool and no HEAD-write tool in this runtime`. The card is `onhold`, escalated with a 4-command hand-over, re-armed 11-20T13:00Z.
3. **The demo cannot run before the commit + a rebuild** (`91411767`, no node/npm). `2cd6e1f6` moved to **Mon 2026-11-23T15:00Z**, pull-forward to Fri 11-20T18:00Z only if commit + Node land by 11-20T12:00Z.
4. **The node precondition on the commit was withdrawn by PM** — a gate nobody can satisfy was a deadlock, not a quality bar. Executed-test evidence is therefore **0 tests**, carried as an accepted residual risk; QA's own numbers stand (0 client tests, 0 pytest).

**How to read A/B/C now:**
- **A — release the increment on human-committed code, no executed tests.** Still the recommendation *if and only if* `git show --stat HEAD` shows exactly 3 paths by 11-20T13:00Z. The refusal-banner path (`EffortsSettings.vue:375-378 → :381-382 → :49-52`) is code-reviewed and traced, which is the best evidence this environment can produce.
- **B — hold until Node exists.** Honest, but it turns an infrastructure decision into an indefinite slip and keeps a fixed customer-visible bug in the tree.
- **C — ship the whole dirty tree.** Reject: ~+28000 lines, 5 features, and it would commit a **dependency downgrade** (`vue3-virtual-scroller ^2.0.3 → ^0.2.3`).

**Decision I need from management at 16:00Z:** confirm A on condition, or accept the Monday slip. If HEAD is unchanged at 13:00Z on 11-20, the answer defaults to **NO-GO → Monday 11-23**, reported as a decision, not as news.

**Option C was rejected for an inverted reason — corrected inputs for the 11-20T16:00Z call.** (PM shift 8, turn 2)

New fact, proven: `vue3-virtual-scroller@2.0.3` → **404 at the npm registry**, and HEAD's committed lockfile already pins `0.2.3`. So the dirty `package.json` line is **the fix that makes HEAD installable**. My shift-8 framing ("C would commit the dependency downgrade") was wrong.

Restated options:

- **A — conditional go (RECOMMENDED, unchanged).** Release on the human-committed tree: 4 paths. Residual risk explicit: **0 tests executed** (no node → `91411767`).
- **B — hold until node exists (unchanged).** Honest, but indefinite; the customer-visible delete defect stays uncommitted and the demo slides without a new date.
- **C — commit the 3 slice files only, leave `package.json` behind (REJECTED).** It lands the efforts fix on a HEAD whose `package.json` demands a version that does not exist, so the demo/staging image cannot be rebuilt. This is the option that violates "deployable on its own".

Second new input: the slice is **4 paths / 4 files**, not "3 files + 1 hunk" — `src/api/modules/efforts.js`, `src/views/EffortsSettings.vue`, `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`, `package.json`. Any commit whose `git show --stat HEAD` shows more than those is out of scope.

Third: the tree is **176 paths, +42569 / -1006** vs HEAD (voice, browsers, computers, CompanyView, untracked `ciso.js`). That is why "commit everything" is not on the table.

Default if nobody answers by 16:00Z: **NO-GO → demo 11-23T15:00Z**, reported as a decision, not as drift.

**One more input for the 16:00Z call: the demo script had a defect, and it must not be read as a code failure.** (PM shift 8, turn 3, 14:57Z)

I reviewed the pending code this turn (the first actual read of it; no test can run). Verdict: **the fix is correct** — `efforts.js` returns the envelope, `EffortsSettings.vue:375-378` throws on it, the `alert-error` banner renders. But the demo script built on top of it was wrong: it asked a presenter to delete a **built-in** effort, and that button is `:disabled="saving || isNew || draft.builtin"` — unreachable. Corrected on `2cd6e1f6` to use a profile-linked effort (409 path, which is the reachable one).

**Consequence for A/B/C, and it is a small one:** if the M1 demo is run on Friday and step 1 fails, check *first* whether the corrected script was used. A demo run against the old script fails by construction and says nothing about the code. Do not turn that into a NO-GO.

So the standing options are unchanged, with one clarification:
- **A (recommended, conditional go)** — go on code committed by a human via the 4 paths `package.json`, `src/api/modules/efforts.js`, `src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue`, `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`; accepted residual risk: **0 tests executed** (no node runtime).
- **B** — hold until Node exists in the QA image. Honest, indefinite.
- **C** — commit only the code files and leave `package.json` behind. Rejected: HEAD's `^2.0.3` **404s on the registry**, so the demo image cannot be rebuilt.

Decision default if nobody answers by 16:00Z: **NO-GO → 11-23**, reported as a decision taken by default, not as a delay.

Note the path correction: `src/views/EffortsSettings.vue` **does not exist** — it appeared in four of my reports. The real file is `src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue`. Any earlier document of ours carrying the `src/views/` path is wrong.

**Final de-risking input for the 16:00Z call: the uninstallable dependency has zero runtime blast radius.** (PM shift 8, turn 4, 15:03Z)

`vue3-virtual-scroller` occurs **only** at `package.json:64`. No import anywhere in `src/`. Consequences for the A/B/C decision:

- Option **A** (conditional go on human-committed code) is safer than I stated at turn 3: the risky-looking `package.json` line cannot affect behaviour, it only affects whether `npm ci` can run. The increment's customer-visible behaviour is untouched by it.
- Option **C** ("commit the 3 slice files and leave `package.json` behind") remains rejected, but for the precise reason: the *demo image cannot be rebuilt* from HEAD, not because the app would misbehave.
- The residual risk stays exactly one item and it is unchanged: **0 tests executed** (`91411767`, no node/npm, non-root, apt denied). Nothing this shift added a second one.

Decision inputs, consolidated:
1. Slice = **4 paths, +20/-10**: `src/api/modules/efforts.js` +8/-3 · `src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue` +8/-1 · `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` +3/-5 · `package.json` +1/-1. Any path matching `src/views/` is a **wrong-scope commit**, not a success.
2. Code reviewed by reading, not by tests: `efforts.js` returns the server envelope; `EffortsSettings.remove()` throws on `status_code`; `catch` sets `this.error`; banner at `:49`.
3. Demo script corrected (`2cd6e1f6`) — built-in delete is `:disabled`; use a profile-linked effort. A failed demo step 1 is a **script** failure until proven otherwise.
4. Commit is human-only; deadline **2026-11-20T12:00Z**. Without it: **NO-GO**, demo stays 2026-11-23T15:00Z.

Default if no answer before the checkpoint: **NO-GO → 11-23**, reported as a decision, not as drift.

## QA evidence pack, 2026-11-20T08:25Z — read this before choosing A/B/C

All four numbers re-measured this shift; nothing is quoted from an older report.

| gate | command | result today |
| --- | --- | --- |
| client JS | `qa_run_tests(suite='npm')` | **block**, HIGH `tests.no-runner`, 0 tests, 0.0s (`npm not found in PATH`) |
| python | `qa_run_tests(suite='pytest')` | **require_approval**, MEDIUM `tests.run-error`, 0 collected, 0.0s |
| coverage | `qa_coverage()` | **warn**, LOW `coverage.unavailable`, threshold 70.0, no report |
| mapping | `qa_review_changes(scope='all', run_tests=false)` | **require_approval**, 11 × `change.missing-tests`, mapped 1 / unmapped 73 |

**0 tests execute anywhere.** The efforts increment has never been executed by any test runner: the client suite exists (`package.json:14` → `node --test tests/`), its 12 files are present, but no runtime resolves. `client/tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` (9 cases) is inspected-correct and unexecuted.

### One framing change since this card was written
The client verdict is no longer `require_approval` — because the suite is now *declared*, a missing runner is HIGH and the verdict is `block`. So **option A ("release with require_approval on the client") no longer describes the tool output.** The two honest choices at 16:00Z are:
- **B** — release as *knowingly unverified*, written down, with the exact test ids that would have covered it;
- **C** — hold until `node`/`npm` reaches the QA runtime (card 91411767: one binary, still open, no image change attempted).

My recommendation as QA: **B with explicit written acceptance**. The gate cannot improve before 16:00Z, and a `block` nobody can action is only a delay — but it must be recorded as "unverified", never as "verified".

Re-verification command after any fix: `qa_run_tests(suite='npm', paths=['tests/effortsApi.test.mjs'])` → expect passed 9 / failed 0.

## PM shift 11 (2026-11-20 09:36Z) — the decision is intact, but option B is mispriced. Read this before the 16:00Z call.

Three premises in this card were true on 11-19 and are now **false**, verified read-only against `HEAD = 361e2c16` with `project_changes`:

| Premise as written | State at 09:35Z today | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| "Automated tests stay red-blocked, no suite" | The suite **is declared**: `package.json:12` = `"test": "node --test tests/"`, **unmodified vs HEAD** → committed | `project_read_file package.json` |
| "the 9 tests can actually run" is the missing bit | `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` is **committed** (139 lines, 9 cases, incl. the 409-envelope case) | `project_read_file tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` |
| "3-path commit landed?" is unverified (`f48294e8`) | `src/api/modules/efforts.js` and `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` are **tracked and identical to HEAD** → they are in the repository | `project_changes` base `HEAD` does not list either file |

Also confirmed committed: `vue3-virtual-scroller: ^0.2.3` in `package.json` (the lockfile-range fix of `651535b1`).

### The re-pricing (this is the PM input to the decision)
Option B was written as *"delay of unknown length"*. That is no longer the right price, because **an operator path demonstrably works in this repository**: the four files above were committed from outside the agent runtime, while 89 files (+4328/-4286) still sit uncommitted. So an operator cannot only commit — an operator can equally run `npm test` on a machine that has `node`.

That yields a fourth option that dominates A and B:

| Option | What management accepts | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| **D (new, recommended)** | Release the efforts increment **after** a one-off operator run of the declared suite today, before 16:00Z: `cd client && npm test` (or `node --test tests/`), counters pasted on this card. Expected `# pass 9 / # fail 0`. Platform fix `91411767` stays a follow-up, not a gate. | ~15 minutes of an operator's time |
| A | Release knowingly unverified, tests red-blocked indefinitely | zero now, unbounded verification debt |
| B | Hold until `node` reaches the QA runner image | 24-48h devops lead time, demo slips |
| C | Flag + management-only demo | one extra deploy cycle, still unverified |

**Recommendation: D, falling back to A only if no operator is reachable today** — and if A is chosen, the card must read "unverified", never "verified" (QA's own wording on this card, 08:29Z).

### What I could not do, stated plainly
I cannot run the suite and I cannot close `91411767`: this shift's tool set has **no exec and no `qa_run_tests`/`security_review_changes`** — the same gap documented on `3a86fba9`. Everything above is read-only repository evidence.

**Decide-by stands at 2026-11-20T16:00Z.** If management answers D, the attached demo script (load presets → try to delete a server-refused preset → **red banner appears** → record still listed) is unchanged and valid.

**Pre-loaded facts for the 16:00Z decision — the question has moved since this card was written.**

The scenario this card was built for ("commit the increment with no executed tests") no longer applies: **there is nothing left to commit.** The three efforts paths and `package.json` are clean vs HEAD and carry the fixed content — `efforts.js` returns the envelope, `EffortsSettings.vue` `remove()` throws on `status_code` (:376), `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` has its 9 cases (139 lines), `package.json` has `"test": "node --test tests/"` and `^0.2.3`. So the increment is *already shipped in a commit*; the open question is retroactive.

Restated decision: **do we accept the efforts delete fix as M1 content while its 9 tests have never been executed?** Constraints, unchanged: no node/npm in this runtime (91411767), so the suite cannot run here at all; the fix is 5 lines of guard code in a screen that fails visibly (red banner), not silently.

My recommendation, and the only option I can defend to management alone: **B for M1, A as the definition of done before the customer flag flip.**
- **B (recommended):** demo M1 on the delete behaviour — built-in effort → red banner, throwaway effort → disappears (script already on card 2cd6e1f6). Acceptance is by observed behaviour, and the test file travels as a spare that someone runs in a node-capable environment (card a0f362ed). Risk accepted and *written down*.
- **A:** block M1 until the 9 tests run somewhere with node. Cost: unknown external lead time, no date I can commit to, and M1 loses the 11-23 demo.
- **C:** revert the delete fix and demo only list/edit. Cleanest verification story, reopens card fcf65219 and makes the delete button lie again — a worse defect than an unrun test.

So: B now, and the decision that actually needs management is a *deadline* — by when must a node-capable environment exist, or the 9 tests stop being "temporarily unrun" and become "never written". My proposal: 2026-11-27, tied to 91411767.

PREMISE CORRECTED before the 16:00Z run — read this first, the description is stale.

The efforts increment is already in the tree/HEAD: `src/api/modules/efforts.js`, `src/components/global_settings/EffortsSettings.vue`, `tests/effortsApi.test.mjs` and `package.json` all report "No changes found" vs HEAD (PM shift 12), while `.codx` churn is still moving. So there is no longer a commit to release; the decision is about DEMOING and about the missing test gate.

Options as of now:
- A — demo M1 on the committed build now, accept the never-executed suite as residual risk.
